title: PARENT-BALANCED WITHIN-DOCUMENT CANDIDATE GENERATION
natq_validation_status: DEVELOPMENT / MODEL-SELECTION DATA; not independent validation

hypothesis.statement: Guaranteeing a minimal lexical + projection candidate contribution from each already-found SYSTEM-H parent improves candidate evidence coverage versus SYSTEM-H's global L=10 / P=20 extras on NATQ-001 validation n=40 (development / model-selection data).

pipeline.reuse_SYSTEM_H_candidate_generation: A pool-100 + E-L10 L=10 + projection C_P P=20, exact existing code. Recompute because stored EVAL-NATQ-VAL-001 pools.jsonl lacks full union member ids. Reuse stored parent lists after identical recomputation check. No CE.
pipeline.additive_parent_balanced_bm25: TOP 1 canonical per SYSTEM-H parent from the same local_bm25_per_parent_batched lists used by E-L10 (cs_v1_control, full-corpus IDF, tokenizer query_terms, ORDER BY round(score numeric 9) DESC, chunk_id ASC). Does not alter L=10 extras.
pipeline.additive_parent_balanced_projection: Restrict existing globally scored projection_rrf hits to version_id==parent; apply exact map_to_canonical_extras unique-canonical ranking (every covering_chunk_id receives that projection fused score; max wins; sort (-best_fused, chunk_id ASC)); take k=1. Does not alter global P=20. Does not recompute parent-local BM25/dense/RRF ranks. Does not invent an overlap heuristic among covering chunks of one projection.
pipeline.union: SYSTEM-H existing union (C_E UNION C_P) UNION parent-balanced BM25 UNION parent-balanced projection; dedupe canonical chunk_id; never remove SYSTEM-H candidate. Max <=20 extra canonicals before dedup (1 BM25 + 1 projection per parent; PARENT_N=10 cap).

projection_mapping_behavior.rule: for each fused projection hit, every covering_chunk_id receives that hit's fused score (max if several projections cover the same canonical); unique canonicals sorted by (-best_fused, chunk_id ASC); C_P = first P previously absent from C_E
projection_mapping_behavior.stop_condition_resolution: Assignment said STOP rather than invent a new multi-cover rule. Existing mapping already defines unique-canonical ranking. EXP-020A applies that ranking with k=1 per parent over parent-restricted globally scored projection hits. Not a new rule. Not 'top-1 projection then emit all its covering chunks'.
